apps.name: Among Us
apps.description: Among Us turns a simple premise into endless social deduction. Work alongside your crewmates to keep the ship flying, or take the role of the impostor and quietly eliminate everyone before the meeting catches on.
highlights: Ten-player social deduction across maps
Crewmate tasks with a satisfying variety
Impostor mode with sabotages and kills
Cross-play with PC, console and mobile
apps.whatsNew: The newest season added a map variant and a new role, matchmaking rebalance made lobbies fairer, and the mobile port renders smoother on older devices.

apps.name: Angry Birds 2
apps.description: Angry Birds 2 is a physics puzzler where a flock of furious birds is the only ammunition you have. Peel back structures, trigger chain reactions and squeeze the last green pig out of impossible towers.
highlights: Tens of hand-designed physics levels
A dozen bird types with unique abilities
Daily challenges and event levels
Fully playable offline
apps.whatsNew: Event levels now rotate faster, the bird roster gained a new mid-tier flier, and physics performance improved on low-end devices.

apps.name: AntennaPod
apps.description: AntennaPod is a free podcast client with no ads, no tracking and no algorithm deciding what you hear. It downloads episodes for offline listening, supports chapters, and syncs playback position across devices.
highlights: No ads and no tracking whatsoever
Automatic episode download rules
Playback position and subscriptions sync
Chapters, chapters-only downloads and transcripts
apps.whatsNew: The episode list loads faster on large feeds, sleep timer gained a fade-out, and a new filter makes it easier to find unplayed episodes.

apps.name: Bitwarden
apps.description: Bitwarden stores passwords, passkeys, cards and notes inside an encrypted vault that you control. Autofill works across apps and browsers, and self-hosting is a genuinely supported option rather than an afterthought.
highlights: Passwords, passkeys, cards and secure notes
Autofill for apps and web forms
End-to-end encrypted sync you can self-host
Vault health report for weak and reused passwords
apps.whatsNew: Passkey support expanded to more apps, autofill is faster on cold start, and the vault report can now suggest generated replacements.

apps.name: Bloons TD 6
apps.description: Bloons TD 6 is the definitive modern tower defence game: sixty maps, dozens of monkey upgrades, hero units and a par system that turns every track into a puzzle of leak prevention. It rewards planning far more than reflexes.
highlights: Sixty maps with rotating game modes
Towers, heroes, upgrades and alchemist chemistry
Co-op and daily challenges
Deep progression with a large unlock tree
apps.whatsNew: A new hero and two towers landed in the latest patch, co-op saves are more stable, and the map editor added background painting.

apps.name: Brave Browser
apps.description: Brave blocks ads and trackers by default instead of asking you to opt in. Chromium compatibility means every site keeps working, while Brave Shields, a built-in Tor private mode and encrypted DNS handle the rest quietly in the background.
highlights: Ads and trackers blocked on every device
Built-in password manager with sync
Tor private mode and fingerprint resistance
Rewards for opting into privacy-preserving ads
apps.whatsNew: Fingerprint protection now covers more surface area, Brave Search gained a summary mode, and tab groups sync faster between phone and desktop.

apps.name: DuckDuckGo Browser
apps.description: DuckDuckGo searches the web without building a profile of you. Its App Tracking Protection blocks cross-app trackers across the whole device, and the browser scrubs tracking parameters from links before you even tap them.
highlights: System-wide App Tracking Protection
Private search that never stores personal history
Fire button that wipes tabs and data instantly
Automatic link and tracker cleanup
apps.whatsNew: App Tracking Protection now covers more system services, search results render faster, and the Fire button clears downloads as well as tabs.

apps.name: F-Droid
apps.description: F-Droid is an installable catalogue of free and open source software. Every build is compiled from the original source with no tracking, no ads and no proprietary blobs, and updates arrive straight from the developers.
highlights: Thousands of free and open source apps
Automatic updates with rollback support
No tracking, no ads, no permissions bloat
Repository manager for custom app lists
apps.whatsNew: Update history is clearer, the package list renders faster on large repositories, and anti-feature badges now show a short explanation.

apps.name: Firefox
apps.description: Firefox is the last major browser with an independent engine. Total Cookie Control, tracker blocking and a redesigned address bar give you real control over what the web knows about you, on every device.
highlights: Total Cookie Control with per-site permissions
Enhanced tracking protection out of the box
Picture-in-picture and background tab previews
Firefox Sync for bookmarks, tabs and passwords
apps.whatsNew: The address bar now searches faster with fuzzy matching, PDF rendering improved on tablets, and Android 15 devices get smoother scrolling.

apps.name: Hill Climb Racing 2
apps.description: Hill Climb Racing 2 is a one-button physics racer about the balance between torque and fuel. The hill never ends, the suspension is never quite right, and the garage full of upgrades is always one run away.
highlights: One-touch physics across endless country and city hills
Deep vehicle upgrades and 40+ vehicles
Team mode with custom leaderboards
Offline play with cloud save sync
apps.whatsNew: Suspension tuning got a wider range, the team system added seasonal cups, and physics was rebalanced for smoother landings.

apps.name: Jellyfin
apps.tagline: Your media server, in your pocket
apps.description: Jellyfin connects to your own media server so your films, series and music follow you to any screen. There is no account to create, no subscription to pay, and nothing leaves your house unless you ask it to.
highlights: Free and open source media server client
Offline downloads for travel
Live TV and DVR with guide data
Hardware transcoding through the server
apps.whatsNew: Chapter support in the web player, better subtitle styling, and the Android TV client now supports multi-user profiles.

apps.name: Joplin
apps.description: Joplin is an open source note-taking app that keeps markdown notes, checklists, links and attachments in sync across devices. End-to-end encryption is available, and notes can be exported in one click so you are never locked in.
highlights: Markdown notes, checklists and attachments
End-to-end encryption with master password
Web clipper for saving pages
One-click export to Markdown, HTML or PDF
apps.whatsNew: Note search is faster on large vaults, the mobile editor handles long documents better, and the share target can now batch-import URLs.

apps.name: KeePassDX
apps.description: KeePassDX is a single-file password manager that keeps everything on your device inside an encrypted database. It opens standard KDBX files, so your vault is not tied to any company that can change the price or shut down.
highlights: Local encrypted database, no account required
Autofill support through the keyboard
Opens standard KDBX files from any KeePass client
Import and export to CSV
apps.whatsNew: Biometric unlock is faster, the database unlock screen got biometric icons, and autofill now handles multi-field forms better.

apps.name: Krita
apps.description: Krita is a professional painting program built for artists who think in layers, brushes and frames. It runs on a tablet with pen pressure support just as happily as it does on a phone, and it stays completely free.
highlights: Over 500 brushes with tagging and presets
Full layer stack with masks and filters
Pressure-sensitive stylus support
Animation and storyboard timeline
apps.whatsNew: Brush engine performance improved for large canvases, colour smudge is smoother, and the tablet HUD can be moved to any edge.

apps.name: Limbo
apps.description: Limbo is a monochrome puzzle platformer with a child, a shadow and forty levels of deceptive machinery. There is no text, no tutorial and no hand-holding, just an atmosphere that made an entire genre look the way it does.
highlights: Forty hand-built levels with hidden mechanics
Iconic silhouette art and sound design
Playable on phones and tablets offline
A once-in-a-generation indie classic
apps.whatsNew: Performance on high-refresh displays was improved, the final chapter runs slightly faster, and a new accessibility option reduces screen shake.

apps.name: Material Files
apps.description: Material Files is a file manager that respects the design language of your phone. It browses internal storage, SD cards, SMB shares and FTP servers through one consistent, gesture-driven interface.
highlights: Material You design that follows your wallpaper
Search, filters and a breadcrumb path bar
Archive, checksum and text preview tools
Support for SMB, SFTP and FTP locations
apps.whatsNew: Thumbnail caching is faster on large folders, SMB connections now survive screen rotation, and the file preview sheet gained a dark-only mode.

apps.name: Minecraft
apps.description: Minecraft is the sandbox that rewrote what games could be: an infinite procedural world of blocks to break and place, a survival mode with hunger and mobs, and a creative mode for building whatever you can imagine. Redstone included.
highlights: Infinite procedural world to explore and shape
Survival, creative and adventure modes
Multiplayer realms with friends
Redstone engineering and mob-based farms
apps.whatsNew: Caves and cliffs generation was refined, the touch control scheme was reworked, and Bedrock performance improved substantially on mobile hardware.

apps.name: Monument Valley
apps.description: Monument Valley is a quiet, impossibly beautiful puzzle game about a princess and an endless set of monuments. By rotating the world you align pathways that should never meet, turning perspective into the whole mechanic.
highlights: Optically impossible architecture as the puzzle
Hand-crafted levels with no timers or fail state
Award-winning art direction and score
Monument Valley 2 and two expansions included
apps.whatsNew: The remastered chapter renders sharply on high-density screens, touch controls are slightly more responsive, and the game now remembers per-level progress after reinstalls.

apps.name: NewPipe
apps.description: NewPipe extracts streams from YouTube and hands them to a player you control. No ads, no background tracking, no Google services required, and a download button that stores anything offline in a single tap.
highlights: Ad-free background playback
One-tap offline downloads in any format
Runs without Google Play Services
Piped and Invidious instance support
apps.whatsNew: Playback of age-restricted content via logged-in cookies works again, the queue gained drag and drop, and app start time dropped noticeably.

apps.name: OsmAnd
apps.description: OsmAnd turns your phone into a proper offline navigator with contour lines, cycle routes, hiking trails and detailed lane guidance. Maps download on demand and stay usable with no signal at all.
highlights: Vector offline maps with contour lines
Car, bike, foot and ski routing profiles
Live traffic overlays and lane guidance
OpenStreetMap based and plugin driven
apps.whatsNew: Route recalculation is faster, elevation profiles render more smoothly, and the map style editor gained new terrain shading options.

apps.name: Shizuku
apps.description: Shizuku lets selected apps use system-level privileges through an ADB-connected service, without ever rooting the device. It is the quiet enabler behind a lot of modern power-user customisation tools.
highlights: Grant system permissions without root
Works over wireless debugging
Restartable service with a clear status widget
Open source and ad free
apps.whatsNew: Wireless debugging pairing is more reliable, the service restarts faster after reboots, and the UI now explains each permission in plain language.

apps.name: Signal
apps.description: Signal is a free, open-source messenger that puts end-to-end encryption on every conversation by default. Messages, calls and group chats are protected with a protocol that is documented publicly and audited by outside researchers, so you never have to take a privacy promise on faith.
highlights: End-to-end encrypted text, voice and video calls
Message history that stays on your device, not a server
Groups up to 1000 with shared stories and polls
Disappearing messages, sealed chats and screen lock
apps.whatsNew: Smarter message search now understands phrases and people, story replies are threaded, and call quality on slow networks has improved noticeably. Several battery regressions were also fixed.

apps.name: Spotify
apps.description: Spotify turns a phone into a portable jukebox with millions of tracks, curated playlists and personalised mixes that adapt to your listening. Offline downloads keep the music flowing on a plane or on the underground.
highlights: Millions of tracks and offline downloads
Personalised mixes that learn as you listen
Group sessions for shared listening
Lossless option on the highest tier
apps.whatsNew: The home screen now surfaces fewer, better picks, car mode gained quick-play rows, and audio quality toggles apply without restarting playback.

apps.name: Stardew Valley
apps.description: Stardew Valley is the gentle reset button: inherit a tired farm, then spend your days growing crops, fishing, mining, befriending the village and quietly rebuilding a life. It runs offline and asks for nothing but a little time.
highlights: Farming, fishing, mining and foraging loops
Fourteen friendshipable characters with real arcs
Deep crafting and a seasonal festival calendar
Multiplayer and split-screen support
apps.whatsNew: The 1.6 update expanded the Ginger Island content, added farm buildings to decorate, and improved controller and split-screen handling.

apps.name: Subway Surfers
apps.description: Subway Surfers is the endless runner that defined the genre on mobile. Dash through three rail lines, dodge trains, vault barriers and collect coins at impossible speed, then unlock boards and hoverboards to push further.
highlights: Endless three-lane runner with daily challenges
Character, board and hoverboard upgrades
Tournament leaderboards and mystery boxes
Playable offline once the assets download
apps.whatsNew: A new seasonal map adds stunts and ramps, the daily challenge system now offers bonus rewards, and loading times dropped on mid-range devices.

apps.name: Telegram
apps.description: Telegram delivers messages faster than almost anything else on Android, with chats, channels and bots that sync instantly across every device you own. Chats are stored in the cloud so a new phone is ready in seconds, while secret chats offer an extra layer of end-to-end encryption.
highlights: Cloud sync across phone, tablet, desktop and web
Channels for broadcast and large communities
File sharing up to 2 GB per file
Secret chats with device-bound encryption
apps.whatsNew: Story sharing now supports longer clips, chat folders gained smarter sorting, and the in-app video player supports background audio on Android 14.

apps.name: Termux
apps.description: Termux gives you a real Linux shell on your phone, with a package manager, a full toolchain and no root required. Edit files over SSH, run Python and Node, compile projects and script your device exactly the way you do on a desktop.
highlights: Full package manager with thousands of packages
SSH, git, python, node and C toolchain included
Keyboard-friendly, colour-aware terminal
Session support with tmux
apps.whatsNew: Package installs are faster, the terminal emulator handles wide characters better, and the widget API gained a couple of new actions.

apps.name: Terraria
apps.description: Terraria is a 2D sandbox adventure of enormous scope: mine hundreds of blocks deep, build a fortress, tame the surface, descend into a hostile underworld and survive bosses that genuinely deserve the fight. The mobile port carries the full console experience.
highlights: Massive 2D world with hundreds of enemies and bosses
Crafting, building, taming and fishing
Full multiplayer and Journey mode
Controller support and cloud saves
apps.whatsNew: Mobile controls got a fresh layout option, world generation is smoother on large maps, and Journey mode received new difficulty tiers.

apps.name: VLC
apps.description: VLC plays almost every codec you will ever meet, from an old AVI on a USB stick to a 4K remux with subtitles. It is the last player app you need on Android, and it is completely free with no ads.
highlights: Plays virtually every audio and video format
Hardware-accelerated 4K decoding
Subtitle support with custom styling
Stream to Chromecast, DLNA and other targets
apps.whatsNew: Playback of high-bitrate HEVC files is smoother, the subtitle editor got a redesign, and network streams reconnect faster on flaky Wi-Fi.

apps.name: WhatsApp
apps.description: WhatsApp is the default way billions of people keep in touch. Chats, voice notes, status updates and calls all live in one place, with end-to-end encryption applied to personal conversations by default.
highlights: End-to-end encrypted personal and group chats
Voice, video and picture messages
Status stories that disappear after 24 hours
Works on slow connections with message queuing
apps.whatsNew: Calls now start faster on noisy networks, Status has a new editing window, and chat search results render faster on devices with many conversations.
